hotspots.title: Adorni’s corruption scandal deepens
hotspots.blurb: Manuel Adorni, Argentina's Cabinet Chief, faces mounting pressure over allegations of illicit enrichment and falsified asset declarations. Opposition parties are pushing for his removal through a constitutional censure motion, while allies debate his future amid judicial investigations.
hotspots.affect: This scandal commands attention due to its high moral charge, polarized contention between government allies and opposition, and the potential political fallout for President Javier Milei’s administration.

hotspots.title: Meloni-Trump diplomatic thaw at G7
hotspots.blurb: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni and U.S. President Donald Trump held clarifying talks at the G7 summit in France, easing months of tensions over NATO, Iran, and Middle East policies. Their interactions, including lighthearted exchanges, signal a potential reset in bilateral relations.
hotspots.affect: The thaw is charged due to the symbolic significance of U.S.-Italy relations, Trump’s unpredictable diplomacy, and Meloni’s balancing act between EU skepticism and transatlantic alliances.

hotspots.title: Lega’s internal crisis over Salvini
hotspots.blurb: Matteo Salvini’s Lega faces growing internal dissent as polls show declining support and Roberto Vannacci’s far-right party gains traction. Northern governors like Luca Zaia and Attilio Fontana push for more autonomy, while Salvini struggles to maintain control ahead of a critical party summit.
hotspots.affect: The crisis is charged due to Salvini’s leadership challenges, the rise of Vannacci as a rival, and the Lega’s role in Italy’s right-wing coalition government.

hotspots.title: Trump’s explosive Iran threats and military actions
hotspots.blurb: President Trump announced a tentative U.S.-Iran peace deal, including the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz and sanctions relief, but faced criticism from allies and lawmakers over its terms. The administration also escalated military actions, including a controversial UFC event at the White House and drone attack plots.
hotspots.affect: The Iran deal and military actions are charged due to Trump’s aggressive foreign policy rhetoric, the high stakes of Middle East stability, and internal Republican divisions over the agreement’s terms.

hotspots.title: Vox’s rising influence in Spain’s regions
hotspots.blurb: Vox continues to expand its influence in Spain’s regional governments, particularly in Andalusia and Castilla y León, where it secured key policy concessions from the PP. The party’s hardline stance on immigration, national priority policies, and anti-corruption measures fuels its growing role in coalition deals.
hotspots.affect: Vox’s rise is charged due to its polarizing policies, the erosion of traditional bipartisanship in Spain, and the party’s ability to shape regional governance despite national opposition.
